query:
SELECT
                lnk.task_id AS "task_id!",
                tl.id AS "label_id!",
                tl.org_id AS "org_id!",
                tl.name AS "name!",
                tl.color AS "color!",
                tl.created_at AS "created_at!",
                tl.updated_at AS "updated_at!"
            FROM task_label_links lnk
            JOIN task_labels tl ON tl.id = lnk.label_id
            WHERE lnk.task_id = ANY($1)
            ORDER BY tl.name ASC
